title: Argentinian Seafood Empanadas
description: A classic Argentinian dish featuring savory seafood filling wrapped in crispy empanada dough.

ingredients.name: seafood mixture
ingredients.notes: Combine 1/2 cup chopped shrimp, 1/4 cup chopped squid, 1/4 cup chopped mussels, and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley

instructions: Roll out empanada dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of seafood mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press edges to seal.
Brush tops with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of nutty salsa, if desired.
